# situation: the job deploys to the URL of the configuration variable
#   DEPLOY_URL, but the step writes vars.DEPLOY_ULR.
# reason: no level defines DEPLOY_ULR (the repository level defines
#   DEPLOY_URL and NODE_VERSION, and the environment production defines
#   PRODUCTION_KEY_ID), so the script gets the empty string as the URL.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: production
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh "${{ vars.DEPLOY_ULR }}"
